summary: Short kerb outside houses at a school corner, with No Stopping signs.
reasons: No Stopping Any Time signs at both ends

best_section.where: Ward Street north kerb, mid-block between the two corners

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 6 m and 11 m from the kerb, more within 20 m; carport at 17 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park on the verge side but the block is short and signed at both ends.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street near a school; school-day drop-off traffic.
drivers.convention: Two cars parked on this kerb, but within the signed no-stopping zones and beside homes.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs at 0.1 m and 0.4 m from kerb line
